_note: Every cookie and web-storage key Shadow sets. Tests (frontend/tests/unit/browser-storage.test.ts and backend/tests/test_browser_storage.py) fail when the code and this list differ. Update the browser storage notice (backend/legal/storage.*.md) in the same change. All entries are strictly necessary or the person's own preferences; no analytics or advertising storage is used.

cookies.name: shadow_session
cookies.purpose: Keeps the person signed in (an opaque session identifier; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production).
cookies.lifetime: Up to 8 hours (AUTH_SESSION_MAX_AGE_SECONDS); removed at sign-out.

cookies.name: shadow_oidc_flow
cookies.purpose: Protects the sign-in round trip to the identity provider against forgery (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, limited to the sign-in callback path).
cookies.lifetime: 10 minutes; removed when the sign-in completes.

localStorage.purpose: Remembers the chosen language on this device so signed-out pages use it.
localStorage.lifetime: Until the person clears site data.

sessionStorage.purpose: Tells the sign-in page whether the session ended unexpectedly, so it can say so.
sessionStorage.lifetime: Until the browser tab is closed.

sessionStorage.purpose: Lets the sign-in page confirm a deliberate sign-out once.
sessionStorage.lifetime: Until the next page load; removed after one use.

identityProvider.name: authentik_session
identityProvider.purpose: Authentik's own session on the identity host (not set by the Shadow application; verify the names against the running Authentik version).

identityProvider.name: authentik_csrf
identityProvider.purpose: Authentik's own forgery protection on the identity host.
